cards.name: Phlogistic Uprising!

effects.printed_clause: Fusion Summon a FIRE Dragon from GY/Extra using hand/field materials sent to GY and/or GY materials shuffled into Deck, then optionally pay LP in 300 multiples.
effects.lua_implementation: The hybrid hand/field-to-GY and GY-to-Deck material handling is supported. The Fusion candidate callback uses Omega's official (c,e,tp,mat,f,chkf) argument contract, clones the supplied material Group, and removes the candidate so a Fusion Monster selected in the GY cannot become its own material.

official_references.matched_structure: Fusion Summon using GY materials with alternate material disposition.
Fusion material selection that shuffles GY/banished materials into Deck.

effects.issue: The callback-smoke failure was a harness argument-name false positive: official Fusion filters receive a Group in the fourth parameter, while the harness maps the conventional name mat to its Group fixture. The canonical callback now uses that explicit name and preserves the required clone/remove-self logic.

effects.printed_clause: Shuffle "Phlogiston Dragon" from GY; Set this card from GY, banish it when it leaves; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: GY ignition shuffles exact code as cost, Sets this card if legal, and installs leave-field banish redirect under id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Self-Set/revival-style operation with leave-field banish redirect.

cards.audit_note: Adversarial completion review: effect 1 fixed. Prior labels were not treated as evidence.
